entries.title: White House lifts tariffs on some Canadian goods as midterm elections loom
entries.summary: From 30 October, tariffs will be eased on some products, including certain machinery, and placed on others, such as carpets.
entries.title_zh: 中期选举临近，白宫取消对部分加拿大商品的关税
entries.summary_zh: 从 10 月 30 日起，某些产品（包括某些机械）的关税将降低，而其他产品（例如地毯）的关税将降低。

entries.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
entries.summary: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.
entries.title_zh: 两名以色列士兵被枪杀后，以色列军队开始拆除希伯伦的巴勒斯坦建筑物

entries.title: White House says Melania Trump brokered truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
entries.summary: Ukraine and Russia confirm the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.

entries.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
entries.summary: Thirty-four people are also injured in the attack in southern Karak governorate, and a manhunt is now under way.
entries.title_zh: 官员称，约旦教堂葬礼上七人被枪手枪杀
entries.summary_zh: 卡拉克省南部的袭击事件还造成 34 人受伤，目前正在进行搜捕行动。

entries.title: Watch: CCTV footage appears to show gunmen at site of Jordan shooting
entries.summary: Dozens of people had been inside the church for a funeral when the shooting began, local media report.
entries.title_zh: 观看：闭路电视录像似乎显示枪手在约旦枪击现场
entries.summary_zh: 据当地媒体报道，枪击事件发生时，已有数十人在教堂内参加葬礼。

entries.title: Why is John Travolta's old luxury jet in a small Australian town?
entries.summary: The BBC goes on board Travolta’s old Boeing 707 which is being reassembled in a small coastal town.
entries.title_zh: 为什么约翰·特拉沃尔塔的旧豪华飞机会停在澳大利亚的一个小镇上？
entries.summary_zh: BBC 登上特拉沃尔塔的旧波音 707，这架飞机正在沿海小镇重新组装。

entries.title: Who actually controls Ukraine's access to Starlink?
entries.summary: President Zelensky says limits to the technology continue to affect Ukrainian forces, while US officials and Elon Musk offer conflicting accounts of who controls it.
entries.title_zh: 谁真正控制着乌克兰对星链的访问？
entries.summary_zh: 泽伦斯基总统表示，该技术的限制继续影响乌克兰军队，而美国官员和埃隆·马斯克对于谁控制该技术的说法相互矛盾。

entries.title: Denmark to ban mink farming in government U-turn

entries.title: Father who killed Oregon school shooter describes anguish over children he couldn't save

entries.title: Glasgow museums remove mummified remains from public view over ethical concerns
